AI: Understood. I've noted the tech stack, mobile speed constraint, dark aesthetic, and Dec 12 deadline.
User: We also have 84 high-res gallery images to compress using WebP. Her primary clients are luxury commercial architects.
AI: Got it. Ready for the next steps.
